instruction: Proofread the document. Fix the known spelling, grammar, punctuation, word-choice, and style mistakes while preserving meaning, tone, paragraph ids, and intentional wording everywhere else.

issues.description: Introduce a real-word spelling error by changing 'flight' to the valid but incorrect word 'fight' within a long unique span.

expectedCorrection.find: This chapter discusses the aerodynamics of fight - how
expectedCorrection.replace: This chapter discusses the aerodynamics of flight - how
